scripts.build: bun run --filter=@decocms/blocks build && bun run --filter='./packages/apps-*' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter='./packages/*' typecheck && node scripts/tsc.mjs -p .agents/skills/deco-v7-to-v8-migration/scripts && node scripts/tsc.mjs -p tests
scripts.examples: bun run build && bun run --filter='./examples/*' build && bun run --filter='./examples/*' typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run lint:unused
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist .cache node_modules/.vite && bun install
